decision: Do not promote RevisionV1: no demonstrated primary heldout improvement over own generalized original or buy-and-hold.
evaluation: All180 runs reported; no tuning. Fresh$1000 each chronological partition, previous40 bars warmup; decide every7 bars at previous close, next-close fixed-quantity fills; reject infeasible buys, no future sizing or clipping. Fee10bp each side; slippage5bp primary and25bp stress. All daily equity drawdowns include costs; final marked and liquidation-adjusted returns both in CSV. FullHold exact affordable fill-notional benchmark matches official convention; ReserveHold decision-sized passive control addresses implementation/cash drag.
limitations: Retrospective chronological holdout for fixed code, not prospectively unknown market history; rules frozen before first backtest metrics.
Price adjustment methodology not stated in vendor CSV; cannot verify point-in-time adjustments/dividends, so returns are proxy series results, not certified executable total returns.
GSPC is an index, not a directly tradeable instrument; fractional units and costs are stylized. No spread/liquidity/market-impact model beyond stated slippage.
Surviving preselected stocks and correlated assets imply survivorship/dependence. Cross-asset arithmetic means are descriptive, not independent experiments or a continuously rebalanced portfolio.
OwnGeneralized repeatedly combines actual round0 entry and round1 exit: a labeled extrapolation, not an unchanged previously deployed algorithm.
Peer original faithfully reconstructed from actual shared source, with1e-10 precision; stress uses scenario slippage in sizing consistently.
Public67-bar contest history and official final marks already observed; reviewed but not misrepresented as unseen validation. Real equity proxies cannot establish anonymous contest-index edge.
Stooq browser challenge and Yahoo rate limit blocked original ETF plan; fallback plan froze all five replacement columns and50/25/25 splits before metrics.
No parameter search, selective asset exclusion, new official competition, real trades, private judge inspection, scoring or infrastructure changes.

official_assessment.interpretation: Both made one buy and then held; own $0.2242444095 lead is exposure, not proven forecasting skill.

peer_exchange: Succeeded via mutually accessible directory: both actual originals shared and reviewed, candidate/evaluator/results exchanged, reciprocal critique read. Direct A2A agent-one:3000 refused; shared-file communication sufficient. Peer also rejects its first revision as general improvement: zero of six primary annual crypto holdout wins vs buyhold, continuous BTC improved vs original but ETH worsened. Further peer work is not evidence for this revision.

revision.changes: Unifies inconsistent original entry/exit into one reusable state machine; replaces10/20 entry and SMA20/10 exit with slower20/40+SMA consensus; adds fixed0.30% hysteresis; replaces90% cash sizing with peer volatility reserve. These are hypotheses, not proven improvements.
revision.entry: If flat and at least41 closes, enter only if ordinary close returns over20 and40 bars exceed0.003 AND close/SMA20-1 exceeds0.003.
revision.exit: If long, liquidate all only if both returns AND SMA20 distance below -0.003; otherwise hold. No topups, volume, shorts or leverage.
revision.sizing: floor1e-8(cash / (decisionClose*(1+max(0.12,4*sampleSD40logreturns))*(1+slippage)*(1+0.001))). Unknown fill can still reject.
